# §9.3 and §14.2, re-run under §5.9's rules

v3.0's §5.9 settled three things the model had to guess at: **one producer of each kind per realm**, **partial staffing paid pro-rata**, and **a crew on a heist assigned to it** rather than merely away for three minutes. The published tables in §9.3 and §14 were not re-run against that decision. This is the re-run.

Published figures are kept beside the modelled ones. The delta is the point: it is what §5.9 costs, and it is not small.

## Starlight a day — engaged player (§9.3)

| Day | Published | Under §5.9 | Difference |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 2 | 2,100 | 2,016 | -4% |
| 8 | 6,200 | 6,301 | +2% |
| 31 | 17,300 | 14,633 | -15% |
| 91 | 94,100 | 46,817 | -50% |
| 181 | 152,800 | 62,627 | -59% |
| 301 | 256,100 | 122,495 | -52% |

The first month holds. From day 91 the published figures describe a universe §5.9's rules cannot produce, and by day 301 they are roughly twice what it does.

## Keeper levels — engaged player (§14.2)

| Level | Published | Under §5.9 | Drift |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 5 | day 4 | day 4 | +0 |
| 10 | day 12 | day 12 | +0 |
| 16 | day 31 | day 29 | -2 |
| 20 | day 47 | day 45 | -2 |
| 28 | day 90 | day 108 | +18 |
| 40 | day 181 | day 275 | +94 |

Levels 5 to 20 land within two days of the published curve, which is the evidence that the model is reading §5.9 correctly. Level 28 is 18 days late and level 40 is **94 days late** — half a year becomes nine months.

## Which of the three rules costs what

| | Day 8 | Day 91 | Day 301 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| §9.2's staffing table | 9,743 | 59,257 | 150,471 |
| + §5.9 pro-rata staffing | 9,743 | 59,257 | 133,510 |
| + §5.9 crew assigned | 6,301 | 46,817 | 122,495 |

Pro-rata staffing costs nothing until the roster binds, then about 11%. Assigning the crew costs 27 to 35% from the first week, because it is a flat five characters out of the roster whether the player raids once a day or four times — which is exactly the trade-off §11.6 always claimed and F3 measured as absent.

Reproduce: `python3 -m tools.economy_model production`, or set `Config(producers_per_realm_override=1, staffing_rule="pro_rata", crew_assigned_not_timed=True)`.
